d: Hemant Soren on SIR : jharkhand vidhanasbha ke do divsiy vishesh satr ke antim din mukhyamantri hemant soren ne sadan men sarkar ki or se javab dete hue kendr sarkar aur bijepi par nishana sadha... SIR aur MMDR sanshodhan ekt ko lekar mukhyamantri ne kendr ki nitiyon par saval uthae...hemant soren ne SIR par kaha ki jharkhand ki samajik aur bhaugolik paristhitiyan dusre rajyon se alag hain... unhonne dava kiya ki is prakriya men vastavik aur vaidh matdataon ke nam bhi kate gae hain... mukhyamantri ne kaha ki sarkar SIR ka virodh nahin kar rahi, balki iske kam karne ke tarike aur dastavejon…
